##### Project general facts

Floareá Residence is a striking residential development by Mashriq Elite Developments, conceived as a place where imaginative architecture and everyday comfort come together beautifully. The project presents a refined collection of studio apartments, one-bedroom residences and two-bedroom homes, each carefully composed so that living areas flow seamlessly into private spaces. Generous windows fill every layout with natural light, while the interplay of open spaces and intimate corners creates a warm, harmonious ambiance throughout.

Residents enjoy an exceptional collection of amenities, headlined by a stunning infinity pool with a sun shelf and a dedicated children's swimming pool designed for fun and safety. At the heart of the community lies a lush central park with curated pathways, sculptures and greenery, complemented by a splash pad and a shaded outdoor playground where families can gather and unwind. The wellness and leisure offering is equally generous, with a fully equipped gym, a serene yoga studio, steam and sauna facilities, an elegant clubhouse, a BBQ courtyard, an enchanting indoor kids play room and inviting lounge and meeting spaces.

Stepping indoors feels like entering a realm of refined luxury, where opulent materials and thoughtful details are woven together with the utmost care. A grand double-height lobby sets the tone with patterned marble flooring, bespoke lighting and plush seating, while marble feature walls and designer fixtures bring timeless elegance into every residence. Sleek fitted kitchens with integrated appliances and beautifully appointed bathrooms complete the picture, delivering a quality of finish that feels effortless, contemporary and truly special.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a well-established residential district in Dubai known for its accessibility, greenery, and modern infrastructure. The area offers a calm living environment while remaining closely connected to key destinations across the city. Its strategic positioning provides direct access to major road networks, allowing convenient travel to business districts, retail centres, healthcare facilities, and leisure attractions.

The neighborhood is home to well-known lifestyle landmarks and open green spaces, contributing to a relaxed atmosphere within an urban context. Established residential communities surround the area, supporting a sense of stability and long-term livability. Retail outlets, schools, medical facilities, and recreational venues are easily accessible, ensuring that daily needs are met within a short distance.

With seamless connectivity to prominent destinations such as Dubai Hills, Arabian Ranches, Jumeirah Village Circle, and other major hubs, Arjan offers a location defined by everyday convenience. The balance between accessibility and tranquility makes it an appealing setting for residents seeking both urban energy and a comfortable community environment.
